g.text: Candy jars: private estimates and social feedback
Six actual jars, with 259-291 candies each. Each curve uses recorded answers from the same people before and after revision.
How many final reports match the accuracy of 10 initial private reports from that same condition?

a.text: Source: Becker, Brackbill & Centola (2017) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1615978114 | Reanalysis: 28 Sep 2026

g.text: The dotted horizontal reference is specific to each condition. Fractional crossings interpolate expected score.
Intervals resample whole groups, preserving both rounds and every task; >31 retains draws without a supported crossing.
k counts sampled reports from groups originally assigned 40 people. It does not measure the number of people needed to run the discussion.
